data.body: Approval phase resumed after the quiet window. Items 14, 16 (narrowed), 19 (expanded) and 20 approved and filed: 7504 (delete timeout_s / run_eval(dirty=) / two metric seeds), 3803 (make transition --reason honest), 1de3 (wire SupportsIncremental on both Jira providers), 8a31 (structured MCP error identity). Item 17 (ARG sweep) still awaiting the OSS-reversion research. Three findings surfaced during approval were also filed: 296a (rebar search dumps full ticket bodies - 203KB for one search term), 47e9 (complexity-baseline.json has a shrink-only gate but a freely-growable baseline and no CI lock), ae96 (scripts/ is outside every static gate; 78 ruff violations incl. 12 dead noqa, and seven of those files are blocking CI gates invoked from _build-and-test.yml).
